snippet.title: Steam『Hachishakusama | 八尺様がいた夏休み』PV
snippet.description:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4689420/Hachishakusama/
Patreon : http://patreon.com/FukachiWorld
X : https://x.com/FukachiWorld




『彼女はいつも すぐそばにいる』 

村の怪異「八尺様」に好かれた少年のひと夏の運命。
父の都合で訪れた鬼伏村（きぶせむら）。そこで少年・さく はその地にすまう怪異「八尺様」に魅入られてしまった。
その瞬間から、少年の夏は変わった。いつもそばにいて離れない。それは恐怖か、それとも――。

逃げ場のない日々に少年の決断する運命とは。これは、やさしくて怖い和風ハートフルホラーゲーム。





『She Is Always Right Beside You』 

The fate of one summer — a boy beloved by the eight-feet-tall Hachishakusama, the urban legend.

Due to his father’s circumstances, a young boy, Saku, finds himself visiting the rural village of Kibuse with him.
There, he ended up captivating a mysterious Ghost that dwells in the land—Hachishakusama, the eight-feet-tall urban legend.
From that moment on, his summer begins to change.

She is always by his side, never leaving.
Is it fear… or something else?

Trapped in days with no escape, what choice will the boy make?
This is a heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.
